result_payload.proof_nl: Let x be any real number. By the defining property of the floor function, \(\lfloor x\rfloor\le x\). Subtracting \(\lfloor x\rfloor\) from both sides gives \(0\le x-\lfloor x\rfloor\). Since x was arbitrary, this holds for every real number x. This directly proves the lemma. The previous feedback is addressed by keeping the proof exactly at the floor-function inequality and not introducing any unrelated fractional-part identity.
